title: Snowflake Developer
description:
We are looking for two UI Engineers to build and improve a data-intensive adoption

dashboard and its conversational analytics experience. The application runs in

Snowflake and combines interactive KPI dashboards with a chatbot that uses

Snowflake Cortex to answer questions over governed data.

You will turn product and user needs into clear, reliable interfaces; integrate

dashboard and chat experiences with Snowflake-backed services; and improve

performance as data volumes and usage grow. The current application uses Python

and Streamlit, with React and ECharts for a custom chart component. Engineers will

work closely with product, data, analytics, and platform teams.

Tech stack

**Core stack**

- Snowflake data platform and SQL

- Python and Streamlit for the application and dashboard

- JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and CSS for custom UI components

- ECharts or a comparable charting library for interactive visualizations

- Snowflake Cortex / Cortex Analyst for conversational analytics

**Related technologies and practices**

- Snowpark and Snowflake semantic views

- Git-based code review and CI/CD

- UI, integration, and performance testing

- Browser profiling, query profiling, caching, and application monitoring

## What you will do

- Build and maintain responsive dashboard interfaces, charts, filters, drill-downs, and

data tables.

- Develop conversational UI features, including chat history, streaming or progress

states, feedback, and error handling.

- Integrate user-facing features with Snowflake data and services, collaborating on

SQL and data contracts as needed.

- Improve dashboard and chat responsiveness through efficient queries, caching,

pagination, and careful UI state management.

- Make complex adoption metrics understandable through thoughtful information

design and consistent visualizations.

- Write readable, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews, documentation,

and delivery practices.

- Diagnose UI, integration, and performance issues using logs, profiling, and query or

application measurements.

- Partner with stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver incremental

improvements to the product.

## Required qualifications

- 5+ years of professional frontend or UI engineering experience, or equivalent

demonstrated experience.

- Strong JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS skills, with experience building

production user interfaces.

- Experience with React or a comparable modern UI framework.

- Experience building dashboards or other data-heavy applications with interactive

charts, filters, and tables.

- Strong SQL skills and practical experience integrating an application with a

relational or cloud data platform.
